meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 能把你的历史观察记录整理成专注的知识库，加载进对话后，基于它回答问题，并保持追问的上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史创建专注大脑、询问过去工作模式，或汇总某主题经验时触发。

howto.what_en: Based on observation history, Claude can build focused knowledge bases, load them into the conversation, and answer questions from the material, keeping context across follow-ups.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users want to create focused brains from observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.
